title: IMAGE requires https (http is #BLOCKED!), rejects SVG and height/width when sizing != 3, and yields a TYPE 128 rich value
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527 (64-bit), _xlfn.IMAGE(source, [alt_text], [sizing], [height], [width]) is non-volatile and requires an https URL (returning #BLOCKED! for http without fetching, and #VALUE! for other schemes or non-text), validates sizing (0..3 after truncation; any height or width argument when sizing != 3—even omitted—is #VALUE!; sizing 3 requires non-negative sizes with at least one > 0), returns #CONNECT! on HTTP 400-499 and #VALUE! on HTTP 500+/204/SVG/non-image bodies, and produces a _webimage rich value (TYPE 128, ERROR.TYPE #N/A, ISERROR FALSE, ISNONTEXT TRUE, COUNTA 1, COUNT 0, arithmetic #VALUE!, and = comparing source and alt_text while ignoring sizing).
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527 (64-bit) against a local mock server and public URLs on 2026-11-06 and 2026-11-07 (calc-func/src/fetch.rs, calc-host/tests/fetch.rs, and fixtures/fetch/excel-image.xlsx).
